answerSimple:
Yes. The damaging ability of City of Brass is a trigger and as such goes on the stack when City of Brass is activated. However, since the activated ability of City of Brass is a mana ability, it does not go on the stack and instead is resolved instantly. This means that when Addison activates the mana ability of City of Brass, they will get one mana, then the triggered ability goes on the stack. With their newfound mana, they can cast Stunning Reversal in response to the trigger. 

If instead Addison decided to first cast Stunning Reversal and activates City of Brass during the casting process, they would lose the game as the triggered ability would go on the stack above Stunning Reversal and resolve first.
